apply_header_fields.description: ApplyHeaderFields (optional): the page's header fields as typed become its parameters and the list loads again — a temporary source page searches again (Navigate's Find)

enabled.description: Enabled: actions are enabled unless the YAML says enabled: false (a missing value is omitted from the JSON; a plain bool sent false and disabled such actions and their shortcuts)

image.description: Image: the button's icon — a name of the frontend's action icon set (frontend/src/lib/components/icons/actionIcons.ts: New, Edit, Delete, Post, Print, …); without one the button shows a bullet point

items.description: Items: the action is a menu button (a dropdown) with these menu items; each item is an action of its own (run_object, run_page, shortcut). run_object can call a registered function with the current record: "table:Job_Queue_Entry.ShowLineNo" (foundation/functions)

run_page_field.description: RunPageField (optional): the page to open is the number in this record's field (a Navigate line's entries page) instead of run_page

run_page_filter_field.description: RunPageFilterField / RunPageFilterValue (optional): open run_page filtered to filter_field = this record's filter_value field (e.g. the customer's ledger entries)

run_page_filters.description: RunPageFilters (optional): several filters of run_page — each a field of the opened page set to this record's field (value) or a constant (const, an option by its number); classic RunFormLink=A=FIELD(x),B=CONST(y)

run_page_params.description: RunPageParams (optional): page parameters of the opened page (its OnOpenPage / header fields) from this record's fields: parameter → field (Navigate's document_no, posting_date)

PageField.description: Field represents a single field on a page

assist_edit.description: AssistEdit: the field's "…" (classic OnAssistEdit) runs this registered function (run_object "table:Customer.AssistEdit", registered WithAssistEdit) with the card's record

calculated.description: Calculated: not a table field — the page's OnAfterGetRecord trigger fills it per record (page.SetValue; classic page variables shown in a column); read-only, not searchable or sortable. Type (e.g. types.Date) formats it; its caption is tables.<table>.fields.<source>.

caption_class.description: CaptionClass: the caption expression of a page field (classic CaptionClass, i18n/captionclass.go); empty: the table field's

check_box.description: CheckBox: a Yes/No FlowFilter above a matrix shown as a check box (checked: the filter Yes, else none) — a page variable switching the matrix, such as Use Add. Reporting Currency

decimal_places.description: DecimalPlaces: the "min:max" digits after the point the page shows — the page field's own (decimal_places in the page YAML; a calculated field's), else the table field's (filled in at request time)

drilldown.description: Page ID to navigate to on click

drilldown_date_field.description: DrilldownDateField: in a period grid, the date field of the drilldown page the row's dates filter (else the grid's)

drilldown_filter_field.description: Field on target table to filter

drilldown_filter_value.description: Field on current record for filter value

drilldown_page_field.description: DrilldownPageField / DrilldownFilters: the drilldown opens the page whose number is in this record's field, filtered like an action's run_page_filters (Navigate's No. of Records)

editable.description: false: read-only (also from the table field's editable: false)

indent_field.description: IndentField (lists): indent the cell by this field's value of the record, one step per level (the chart of accounts indents names by Indentation)

masked.description: Masked (ExtendedDatatype Masked): shown as a password input, never in clear text. Set in the page YAML (e.g. the User card's virtual password field) or taken from the table field's masked: true

on_after_validate.description: OnAfterValidate: after the field's value is entered and the record saved (classic OnAfterValidate with CurrForm.SAVERECORD), the page runs this registered function with the saved record — quietly: only its questions, the page it opens and errors show ("table:Sales_Line.ReserveAlways")

on_drilldown.description: OnDrilldown: the field's drilldown is this registered function (classic OnDrillDown with code): a click on the value, or Alt+↓, runs it with the saved record, quietly — the page it opens and errors show ("table:Sales_Line.ShowReservationEntries")

on_lookup.description: OnLookup: the field's lookup is this registered function (classic OnLookup): it works on the record as the page has it, may open a page (RunModal) and gives the record back with the fields it set (registered like an AssistEdit: ForAssistEdit, WithAssistEdit) — the page takes it and saves ("table:Sales_Line.SelectItemEntry"); Alt+↓ / F4 or ▼ in a list cell, the "…" on a card

style_expr.description: StyleExpr (lists): the cell takes Style when the record's field equals / does not equal a value (an option by its number) — bold heading and total accounts

PageFixedFilter.description: FixedFilter is an exact-value filter the user cannot remove (filter group 2): a journal's template and batch

expression.description: Expression: Value is a filter expression (a range: ..2026-10-20, <0), not one value

PageHeaderField.description: HeaderField is a field above a list (a page variable): it shows and edits the page parameter Param of the OnOpenPage trigger (e.g. batch). Source names the list field it stands for (its caption and type); its lookup opens LookupPage filtered to the list's filters on the fields of LookupFilters (lookup field → list field) and takes the picked record's LookupField.

options.description: Options (optional): the header field is a choice of these values instead of typed text (a classic option page variable: Report Selection's Usage) — the parameter is the chosen option's Value; its Caption is translated as pages.<page>.options.<param>.<caption key>

PageHeaderOption.description: HeaderOption is a value of a header field with options

PageLayout.description: Layout defines the page layout structure

matrix.description: Matrix: a page that is a matrix of the source table's records against periods (classic matrix forms on a table: Resource Capacity) — the page's matrix section "" (no card record)

PageMatrix.description: Matrix is a card section of a table's records (rows) against periods (columns): each cell is the row record's FlowField Value with the column's period in its FlowFilter DateFilter (View as Net Change: the period, Balance at Date: up to its end), RecordFilters (a FlowFilter of the row → a field of the card record: the budget) and the Filters the user sets above the matrix. With Editable (and the page's OnMatrixValidate trigger) a value typed into a cell is handed to the trigger with the row's record so filtered.

actions.description: Actions: the actions of a card section's matrix, run on the selected matrix row (a run_page filtered by the row's fields, a function on the row's record) — a matrix page's own actions work on its selected row the same way

calculated.description: Drilldown: a cell opens this page filtered to the row (DrilldownRowField = the row's DrilldownRowValue field — when blank its key: a total account's Totaling), the column's dates (DrilldownDateField), the card record (DrilldownRecordFilters: drilldown page field → card field) and the user's filters Calculated: the columns and the cells come from the page's OnMatrixCalculate trigger (an account schedule's column layout) for one period chosen above the matrix (View by, previous/next) — the period goes into DateFilter; RowFilters (a field of the rows → a field of the card record) select the rows (the schedule's lines)

card_date_filter.description: CardDateFilter: a calculated matrix whose rows have no date filter (the dimension values of one G/L account) puts its period into this FlowFilter of the card record instead

closing_entries.description: ClosingEntries: the matrix offers Closing Entries Include/Exclude (the G/L balance views): a period ends at its closing date, Exclude leaves out the fiscal years' closing dates

entry_table.description: EntryTable: the table a value entered writes to (the user needs Insert permission on it)

fields.description: Fields: the row's fields before the cells (indent_field / style_expr as on lists)

filters.description: Filters: FlowFilter fields of the rows the user filters the matrix by (Dimension 1 Filter); drilldown_filter_field: the field of the drilldown page they filter. A matrix with a CardDateFilter filters the card record instead (its FlowFilters: the account's Budget Filter)

no_periods.description: NoPeriods: a calculated matrix whose columns are not periods (Items by Bin: the bins) — no View by, no previous/next

view_as.description: ViewAs: a calculated matrix offers View as Net Change / Balance at Date (the period, or up to its end, in the rows' date filter)

view_by.description: ViewBy: the period length the matrix starts with (0 Day … 4 Year, 5 Accounting Period)

PagePageMetadata.description: PageMetadata contains page metadata and structure

auto_split_key.description: AutoSplitKey (AutoSplitKey): on list pages whose last primary key field is a line number (int), a new line inserted between two lines gets the number halfway between them (lines are numbered in steps of 10000) — document lines

copy_paste_allowed.description: CopyPasteAllowed (CopyPasteAllowed): on list pages, Ctrl+C copies the selected records and Ctrl+V inserts them (same table; new keys from the list's filters, or another company)

delayed_insert.description: DelayedInsert (DelayedInsert): on editable lists, insert a new record only when the user leaves the row, not on the first validated field. For pages where the user types a composite key (e.g. User Members), so no half-entered key is ever saved.

focus_field.description: Field to focus when page opens

footer.description: Footer (list pages): calculated fields shown under the list for the cursor row (a journal's Account Name, Balance, Total Balance); OnAfterGetRecord fills them per row

header_fields.description: HeaderFields (list pages): fields above the list that are not table fields (classic page variables, e.g. a journal's Batch Name) — each edits a parameter of the page's OnOpenPage trigger, which turns it into the list's filters

list_page_id.description: For card pages, the associated list page

source_table_temporary.description: SourceTableTemporary (SourceTableTemporary, list pages): the page shows a temporary record its OnFindRecords trigger fills from the page parameters on every load (Navigate); nothing is read from or written to the table in the database

source_table_view.description: SourceTableView (classic SourceTableView WHERE): fixed filters of a list page, in filter group 2 like an OnOpenPage trigger's SetFilter — the user's filters narrow them and cannot remove them, new records take the single values. value is a value (an option by its number), with expression: true a filter expression (`<>0`, `1|2`)

PagePeriodGrid.description: PeriodGrid is a card section listing periods (days … years, accounting periods) — or, with Rows, the records of a table — with the card record's FlowFields calculated for each: the row's period goes into the FlowFilter DateFilter (View as Net Change: the period, Balance at Date: up to its end). Rows from a table (Item Availability by Location) set their key into the FlowFilter Rows.Filter and share the one period chosen above the grid.

closing_entries.description: ClosingEntries: the grid offers Closing Entries Include/Exclude — a period ends at its closing date, Exclude leaves out the fiscal years' closing dates (the G/L balance views)

columns.description: Columns: FlowFields of the record, or calculated fields its page's OnAfterGetRecord trigger fills for each row; drilldown opens a page filtered to the record (Drilldown filter field/value) and the row's dates (DrilldownDateField)

filters.description: Filters: FlowFilter fields of the record the user filters the grid by (Location Filter)

rows.description: Rows: the rows are the records of a table instead of periods

view_by.description: ViewBy: the period length the grid starts with (0 Day … 4 Year, 5 Accounting Period)

PagePeriodGridRows.description: PeriodGridRows are the records a period grid lists (locations, variants): Table's records — those matching Filters (a field of the row table → a field of the card record, the variants of the item) — keyed by Field and named by CaptionField; each row's key goes into the record's FlowFilter Filter

drilldown_filter_field.description: DrilldownFilterField: the field of a column's drilldown page the row's key filters (location_code)

PageRepeater.description: Repeater represents a repeater (table) on a List page

PageRunPageFilter.description: RunPageFilter is one filter of an action's run_page: Field of the opened page = this record's Value field, or Const, or the range From..To of two of its fields

from.description: From / To: a range of this record's two fields (from..to), e.g. a G/L Register's From Entry No. .. To Entry No.

optional.description: Optional: a blank value sets no filter (otherwise the action needs the value)

PageSection.description: Section represents a section/group on a Card page

matrix.description: Matrix: instead of fields, the section shows a table's records against periods (classic matrix forms: G/L Budget by Periods)

period_grid.description: PeriodGrid: instead of fields, the section shows the record's FlowFields per period (classic matrix-by-periods forms: Item Availability by Periods, Item Turnover)

subpage.description: Subpage: instead of fields, the section shows a list page with the records linked to the card's record (e.g. a document's lines)

PageStyleExpr.description: StyleExpr is a conditional style of a list cell: Style when Field = Equal (or <> NotEqual)

PageSubpage.description: Subpage is a list page shown in a card, tied to the card's record by Link (SubPageLink)

link.description: Link: field of the subpage's table → field of the card's table (e.g. document_no: no); the subpage shows only the records with these values (filter group 2, the user cannot change it), and new records get them

description: PageDefinition represents a complete page definition from YAML
